description: This file defines a Flutter widget class 'HomeScreen' along with several supporting widget classes, representing the main dashboard screen of a mobile application. It manages state initialization, builds a complex scrollable UI with various widgets such as cards, grids, carousels, and handles navigation. It also interacts with providers for state management and external data.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main dashboard screen as a StatefulWidget, manages initialization and builds the primary UI.

classes.name: _HeroIntroCard
classes.description: A stateless widget displaying an introductory card with icon, text, and a button.

classes.name: _QuickActionsGrid
classes.description: Displays a grid of quick action tiles with icons and labels.

classes.name: _KpiRow
classes.description: A row of KPI summary widgets showing key metrics.

classes.name: _ChartPlaceholder
classes.description: Placeholder for a chart, with bar-like visual representation.

classes.name: _RecommendationsCarousel
classes.description: A horizontally scrollable list of recommendation cards based on provider data.

classes.name: _RecommendationCard
classes.description: Card widget displaying a single recommendation with title, subtitle, and CTA.

classes.name: _MockBadge
classes.description: A badge indicating mock or live mode status.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the widget by loading providers (called in didChangeDependencies).
